lines.original: All of the memories we’ve left behind
from beyond the times we reminisce
lines.translation: 从过去的时代，我们缅怀过去

lines.original: You’ve always been there to share it
been there to share the moments with
Even through worst and harshest times
lines.translation: 即使是最糟糕和最艰苦的

lines.original: you’re the one giving me hopes and dreams
lines.translation: 你是给我的希望和梦想的人

lines.original: Smiling for me with wide open arms
never turning away from my side
lines.translation: 永远不要离开我的身边

lines.original: Stories told by the heart of the sea
dreams that flow from the past
The vivid deep blue eyes watching over
through all the endless nights and days,hmm~
Stories told by the rise of the waves
lines.translation: 由波浪的兴起所讲的故事

lines.original: dreams that lead to the future
Closing my eyes, I listen to the story
listen to your dreams
The troublesome clothes that hold you back
the heavy hearted minds that weigh you down
Lift all the weight off your shoulders
cast all the troubles far away
Enjoying the freedom and zest you give
lines.translation: 享受你给的自由和热情

lines.original: as you always had me search in life
lines.translation: 因为你总是在我的生活中寻找

lines.original: Beckoning me with wide open arms
never turning away from my side
lines.translation: 永远不要离开我的身边
